# Michael Ajekigbe

> Cybersecurity compliance consultant and AI security engineer based in Lagos, Nigeria.
> Writes the complete SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST documentation set for small and mid-sized
> businesses in 10 business days, with a late-delivery refund guarantee.

## Who he is

Michael Ajekigbe (GitHub: meosbrand) is a cybersecurity professional specialising in GRC
(governance, risk and compliance) for small businesses, plus AI security engineering.
He holds the Google Cybersecurity Certificate and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure certification,
and is a cybersecurity intern at Samafi Cyberhub. He works remotely across West African,
European and US time zones, and speaks English, Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin.

His stated position: enterprise security vendors write for Fortune 500 CISOs, so small
businesses get ignored or confused. He writes security documentation in plain language for
companies without a dedicated security team.

## Primary service: The 10-Day Compliance Sprint

A fixed-scope engagement delivering, within 10 business days:

1. Fourteen policies mapped to SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, ISO 27001 Annex A and NIST CSF
2. Risk assessment and risk register with named owners and review dates
3. Incident response plan plus a one-page runbook for phishing, ransomware and lost devices
4. Security questionnaire answer bank for enterprise vendor assessments
5. Gap analysis and remediation roadmap (fix today / this month / this quarter)
6. Staff security awareness pack in English, Nigerian Pidgin or Yoruba
7. Vendor review template
8. Thirty days of post-delivery support

Guarantee: delivered in 10 business days or the client pays nothing. Free revisions until
the documentation clears the client's auditor or customer.

Who it suits: B2B companies of 5 to 200 people whose customers are requesting SOC 2 or
ISO 27001 before signing. Requires one 45-minute scoping call and a list of tools and vendors.

Important accuracy note: this service produces audit-ready documentation. It does not by
itself confer SOC 2 certification, which requires an accredited auditor and an observation
window.

## Open-source projects

- Ààbò (https://github.com/meosbrand/Aabo) — security co-pilot for small African businesses.
  Next.js and TypeScript with Google Genkit AI flows. Onboarding, protection dashboard,
  backup centre, panic trigger, and a chatbot explaining threats in local languages.
- Auto-RedTeam ADK (https://github.com/meosbrand/autonomous-ai-pentesting-tool) — autonomous
  AI penetration testing framework. An attacker agent, target LLM and judge loop with a Tree
  of Attacks branching strategy, on Gemini 2.0 Flash, FastAPI and Next.js 14, streamed over
  WebSocket. MIT licensed.
- 403 Bypass Fuzzer (https://github.com/meosbrand/403_bypass_fuzzer) — Bash tool testing 70+
  mutations (path traversal, semicolon insertion, null bytes, Unicode, case alteration)
  against endpoints returning 403 or 401, to find misconfigured access control.
- Ẹgbọ́n Study Partner (https://github.com/meosbrand/Team-Blaze) — AI study companion for
  Nigerian students with automatic subject detection and adaptive explanation strategies.
  Django REST, React, Vite and Gemini. Built for the Build with Oyo 2026 hackathon.
- Snort3 NIDS Installer (https://github.com/meosbrand/Snort3-installer-NIDS-) — one-command
  installer for Snort3 and its dependency chain on Linux.

## Topics he can speak to

SOC 2 readiness, ISO 27001 Annex A controls, NIST CSF, risk registers, security questionnaire
response, vendor risk assessment, incident response planning, small business cybersecurity,
intrusion detection, access control testing, AI red teaming and LLM security, security
awareness training in African languages.
